_comment: Third-party downloads used by the installers, pinned by version and SHA-256. deploy/build.py checks every hash. Python and WinSW go into the Windows installer; FFmpeg is NOT bundled (licence): the Windows installer downloads it from its publisher on the user's machine and checks this hash. To update one, change url + version + sha256 together and rebuild.

ffmpeg_windows.licence: GPL-3.0 (downloaded by the user's installer, never redistributed by BAMS)
